objective: Test two bounded hydrogen-release model claims against previously unopened raw time series from independent, public, actual-hydrogen experiments in a mechanically ventilated enclosure: sensor-array-mean concentration response and local blowdown mass flow.
claim_boundary: This holdout addresses a spatially lumped mean concentration in a mechanically ventilated 60.8 m3 enclosure and local 0.5 mm blowdown mass flow from measured upstream pressure and temperature. It does not validate local plume geometry, detector placement, the 3.86 m discharge-line transient, outdoor hydrogen-refuelling-station dispersion, consequence distance, station controls, or a complete station-to-vehicle loop.

source.title: Experimental data - Hydrogen Safety-mechanical ventilation
source.article_title: Experimental Study of Hydrogen Release Accidents in a Full-Scale Hydrogen Refuelling Station
source.declared_scope: Unignited hydrogen releases in a mechanically ventilated 40 ft ISO container representative of an underground car-park enclosure.

prior_access.blinding_statement: This is a raw-time-series pre-access holdout, not a fully blinded study. The associated article's aggregate methods and outcomes were available before freezing, but no MAT numeric time series was downloaded, opened, plotted, or summarized.

excluded_experiments.1: No Exp01.mat is present in dataset version 1.1.
excluded_experiments.2: No Exp02.mat is present in dataset version 1.1.
excluded_experiments.3: The public article identifies Exp3 as nonrepresentative.
excluded_experiments.17: The public article identifies Exp17 as nonrepresentative.
excluded_experiments.18: The public article identifies Exp18 as nonrepresentative.

locked_extraction.time_alignment: Linear interpolation only within each documented source time base; duplicate source times retain the first value. No time shift is permitted.
locked_extraction.post_release_window: All finite samples at or after MFM.t0; at least 30 paired samples are required.
locked_extraction.dispersion_observation: Arithmetic mean across every concentration head available at each S.time sample.
locked_extraction.mass_flow_observation_window: Finite post-release samples where measured MFM.mfr is at least 10% of the measured case peak and measured Tank.p exceeds 1.01 times ambient pressure.

dispersion.name: zero-dimensional well-mixed hydrogen mass balance
dispersion.hydrogen_density: CoolProp hydrogen density at the locked ambient pressure and temperature
dispersion.initial_condition: measured sensor-array mean at the first retained post-release time
dispersion.integration: closed-form constant-coefficient update over each measured interval

mass_flow.name: local real-gas isentropic aperture relation
mass_flow.upstream_state: measured Tank.p and Tank.T at each MFM.time

primary_endpoints.secondary_descriptive_endpoint: Measured and predicted duration above 4 vol% H2 is reported for dispersion cases but is not used to decide the primary claim.

parameter_policy.format_only_repairs: permitted only when documented in a dated amendment that preserves cases, endpoints, models, parameters and thresholds

aggregate_decision.dispersion_claim_supported: all 18 declared cases are eligible and at least 70% pass the frozen per-case joint screen
aggregate_decision.mass_flow_claim_supported: all 5 declared blowdown cases are eligible and at least 4 pass the frozen per-case joint screen
aggregate_decision.schema_or_runtime_failure_treatment: retained as an explicit failure record and counted against eligibility
